item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Five Café Photos With Music

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical Instagram reel from these five café photos, in the order attached. Add some relaxed instrumental music. No text, just nice smooth transitions.

item.tests: Produces one finished five-photo reel with the requested sequence, smooth transitions and an audible instrumental soundtrack.

answer_sheet.Photos and order: Use all five: storefront, latte, pastries, barista, interior.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Relaxed instrumental music; no vocals or voiceover. Track choice is your call.
answer_sheet.Transitions and framing: Smooth transitions; other editing and framing choices are your call.

must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8-seconds.
All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.
After the follow-up, the final result is about 8 seconds long (the user asked for 2 seconds less); everything else is as before.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical Instagram reel using ALL FIVE supplied café photographs as the actual montage imagery, strictly in this order: @storefront, @latte, @pastries, @barista, @interior. Each photo gets approximately 2 seconds: storefront 0–2s, latte 2–4s, pastries 4–6s, barista 6–8s, interior 8–10s. Preserve the photographed café, objects and people faithfully; do not replace these with newly imagined scenes. Reframe tastefully to fill 9:16, keeping each main subject visible. Subtle slow Ken Burns push-ins or gentle pans, elegant smooth cross-dissolves between photographs, calm warm natural café atmosphere. No added text, titles, captions, logos or watermarks. Audio: relaxed mellow instrumental café music, soft jazzy electric piano, gentle acoustic guitar and understated brushed percussion, no vocals, no speech. Music starts at beginning and gently fades out at 10 seconds. Deliver one complete coherent ten-second photo montage.
